name: Custom cake baker

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Mara and Ines (bakers at the shop)

services.name: Tasting for 2
services.story: The main story: a $55 tasting for 2 with Mara, paid in full when booking. A cake from the price board, like a $40 6-inch cake picked up at the counter, is paid the same way.

services.name: 2-tier party cake (serves 30)
services.story: A $140 2-tier party cake for 30, picked up Sat at 11:00am. A $40 deposit now, and the $100 rest charged to the saved card at pickup.

services.name: Custom cake
services.story: A custom cake picked up at the shop, quoted by Mara from Alex's photos at $90 (Sam OKs every custom cake quote). A $20 deposit when booked, and the $70 rest charged to the saved card at pickup.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Custom tiered cake for 80
services.story: The main story: a 3-tier cake for 80, quoted from Alex's photos at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it). Both sign the contract. A $160 deposit now, and the $480 rest charged to the saved card when Nico texts DONE.

services.name: 2-tier cake for 30
services.story: A $150 2-tier cake for 30 from the menu, delivered. A $40 deposit now, and the $110 rest charged to the saved card at DONE.

services.name: 2-tier cake for 30
services.story: The same $150 2-tier cake for 30, paid in full when booking.

questions_before_times: What it's for, and the event's date and start time
How many servings, and how many tiers if they know
Flavors and fillings, from the menu
Pickup or delivery; for a delivery, the place's name and town
Any food allergies or diets to plan for: yes or no only
safety_stop: Someone is having a bad allergic reaction right now: trouble breathing, a swollen face or throat
A fire or a gas smell, at the kitchen or the venue
license: Always for food: a food permit from the health department for the kitchen the cakes are made in. A home kitchen sells only under its state's cottage food rules. Dessert tables served at a venue may need a serving permit. All from the state form.
staff_skills: ["Custom tiered and wedding cakes (leads only)","Menu cakes, sheet cakes and cupcakes","Delivering and setting up tiered cakes","Tastings and design calls","Dessert tables, with a food manager where required"]
messages_never: Allergies, diets and any health detail stay on the secure page, with their own yes. Only the baker making the cake and the manager see them, for that order. They're deleted the day after the pickup or delivery.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
